# Academic Journal

> A multi-disciplinary open-access academic publishing platform hosting peer-reviewed journals in economics, business, health sciences, and education.

Academic Journal operates several internationally-indexed journals including AJDES (Academic Journal of Digital Economics and Stability), IJBDE (International Journal of Business Diplomacy and Economy), IJHSMS (International Journal of Health Systems and Medical Sciences), and AJSLD (American Journal of Science and Learning for Development). All publications are distributed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License with emphasis on open-access scholarly communication.

## Journal Homepages

- [Academic Journal](https://journal.academicjournal.online): Homepage for AJDES and IJBDE academic journal platform
- [Academic Journal Index](https://journal.academicjournal.online/index.php/index/index): Main index page for Academic Journal publication platform
- [International Journal of Business Diplomacy and Economy](https://journal.academicjournal.online/index.php/ijbde): IJBDE journal homepage with open-access business diplomacy content
- [International Journal of Health Systems and Medical Sciences](https://journal.academicjournal.online/index.php/ijhsms): IJHSMS journal homepage for health systems and medical sciences
- [American Journal of Science and Learning for Development](https://journal.academicjournal.online/index.php/ajsld): AJSLD journal homepage for science and learning development
